scope.definition: Every source reference used by the 24 primary Virginia community-college outcomes and all 15 SCHEV public four-year Computer Science degree outcomes.

hash_semantics: Source sha256 values cover the normalized UTF-8 text bytes used by the collector, not the raw HTML or PDF transport bytes.

classification_policy.exact_local_byte_match: The requirement source sha256 exactly equals the SHA-256 of a retained normalized-text file. Capture-index retrieval metadata is preserved here because pages/ is an intentionally ignored working cache.
classification_policy.documented_transparent_render_transport_: The official origin was blocked by Cloudflare; a transparent renderer fetched the exact official HTTPS origin. URL, retrieval URL, declared render hash, failed direct-origin capture, and complete normalized evidence artifact are explicit. Exact render response bytes are not retained.
classification_policy.url_and_declared_hash_without_retained_b: The official URL and declared observed-response hash remain in the requirement/research artifacts, but no retained local byte sequence reproduces that hash. This classification is provenance evidence, not a claim of byte reproducibility.

provenance_boundary.raw_capture_policy: server/.va-catalogs/pages is an intentionally ignored transport working cache and is not the durable publication artifact. Exact-match byte inventory and retrieval metadata are frozen in this manifest.
provenance_boundary.compact_evidence_policy: Requirement artifacts and the exception-specific nonignored research artifacts retain the catalog identities, requirement facts, source URLs, hashes, and source-specific evidence needed to audit catalog completeness without claiming unavailable response-byte reproducibility.
provenance_boundary.limitation_scope: A non-byte-reproducible source is a provenance limitation only. It is not silently promoted to an exact match and is not, by itself, a catalog-completeness failure.
